shortDescription: China’s electricity consumption topped 1 trillion kilowatt-hours in August, while power load hit a record, according to Bloomberg.The National Energy Administration said on its WeChat account Sunday that power demand remained robust.

title: China August Power Use Exceeds 1 Trillion kWh as Load Sets Record
